inventory.anchor: EXPORTS.mozilla.gfx and UNIFIED_SOURCES of gfx/2d (StealthGlyphCoverage.h and .cpp)
inventory.notes: Exports StealthGlyphCoverage.h and builds StealthGlyphCoverage.cpp. The header declares one free function and includes nothing, because vendored Skia's SkScalerContext.cpp includes it.

This file is in the vendored Skia tree, so every Skia update conflicts with this block. The call sits before the mask filter on purpose: a blur must act on the already quantised mask, as the comment explains. The include is the only Mozilla header in this file (other Skia files do include mozilla/ headers, e.g. gfx/skia/skia/src/ports/SkMemory_mozalloc.cpp:12). The comment says this replaces the readback-time coverage ladder that was removed from CanvasRenderingContext2D.

verifier.why: The claim that this is the only Mozilla header in Skia is false (SkMemory_mozalloc.cpp, SkASAN.h, SkMacros.h, SkTypeface_win_dw.h include mozilla headers); it holds only for this file.

inventory.anchor: the gtk block (TestStealthFontMetrics.cpp) and the WINNT block (TestStealthTextQuality.cpp)
inventory.notes: Registers two gtests inside blocks of other folders: TestStealthFontMetrics.cpp (the average character width on the FreeType path is the one DirectWrite computes) in the gtk block, and TestStealthTextQuality.cpp (the Windows text quality and ClearType parameters come from the declaration) in the WINNT block.

With the engine on, GetSystemTextQuality returns the declared zoom.stealth.text.system_quality (only 0, 4 or 5 accepted; anything else calls StealthRefuse) and never asks SystemParametersInfo. UpdateClearTypeVars skips CreateRenderingParams (stealthDeclared forces E_FAIL) and always applies the declared ClearType values. The six hard-coded defaults remain as the stock Firefox baseline. GDI gamma is still read from the host, on purpose (comment: canvas never uses that path). Movable: the engine-on branches can move into a helper in our own file. Pref read through StaticPrefs; definition confirmed at modules/libpref/init/StaticPrefList.yaml:21885 (zoom.stealth.text.system_quality, RelaxedAtomicInt32, default -1). The ClearType level/contrast/gamma prefs are read by unchanged upstream lines whose condition the diff widens (stealthDeclared ||), they are not added reads.

verifier.why: Pref name confirmed in StaticPrefList.yaml; clarified which reads are added.

inventory.notes: With the engine on, the advance and the ink box come from HarfBuzz design-space values (GetDesignAdvance and GetDesignGlyphExtents) scaled by the unrounded size, not from FreeType's hinted values. No fallback to FreeType on this path (engine rule 7 in comments). The declaredAdvance flag skips the hinting round and the extentsScale multiply. Comments include the measured Courier New case at 13.383333 px. Non-engine behaviour is unchanged. Movable: both declared paths can move into helpers in our own file behind 2-3 line hooks.

verifier.why: Checked category, feature, prefs, anchor, evidence and notes against the diff; no correction needed.
